name: Bering's Great Northern Expedition to America
traveler: Vitus Bering, Aleksei Chirikov and Georg Steller
summary: From Kamchatka the St Peter and the St Paul sail east and find Alaska. The naturalist Steller has ten hours ashore on Kayak Island. On the way home the St Peter is wrecked on an island where Bering and half the crew die of scurvy; the survivors build a boat from the wreck and bring home sea-otter furs that start the Russian fur trade.

stops.note: The St Peter and the St Paul sail together, then lose each other in a storm.
Steller lands for ten hours and collects the first Alaskan specimens.
Meetings with Unangan people; scurvy spreads.
Wrecked; Bering dies here in December.
46 survivors return in a boat built from the wreck, with otter skins.
